|lore=Piloted Red 3 at Battle of Yavin. Childhood friend of Luke. Led mutiny on ''Rand Ecliptic'' and theft of ''Ecliptic'' from shipyards on Bestine. ''Ecliptic'' Evaders emblem on helmet.<ref name="foil-face" />
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 3, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.<ref name="foil-face" />
